title: Wellman on Missouri Voters Face Redistricting Showdown
description:
Fred Wellman, Democratic Candidate for Missouri's Congressional 2nd District and a US military veteran of Iraq, says his time as an Army reservist shaped his view of the burden of leadership as the country marks 25 years since 9/11. Wellman says Missouri’s redistricting fight created confusion for voters and discusses his campaign’s effort to reach voters across the district following the court decision. Wellman discusses his strategy for competing in the congressional race despite a significant fundraising gap with his opponent. He speaks with Tyler Kendall on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power."
